subject: Decision authority list, signature window and kickoff cadence for Avery MAP
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@averyretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@averyretail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP + decision authority & signature window

Hi Claire / Avery procurement team —

Attached is the latest Mutual Action Plan (Avery_MAP_v3.pdf) and the short evaluation summary from our lab run (Eval_Summary_Avery_20250724.xlsx). We consolidated the items we agreed on in the last call and laid out the remaining gating items for go/no-go: legal redlines, procurement PO, and confirmation of start date.

Quick asks so we can lock a final cadence this week:
- Can you confirm the decision authority list (who must sign/approve internally and by role)?
- Do you have a preferred signature window next week (we typically see fastest turnover with a 48–72 hour window once legal gives the greenlight)?
- Any procurement PO number or internal reference we should include on the DocuSign envelope?

If it helps, proposed signature windows: Aug 6–8 (e-sign), Aug 11–12 (alternate). Proposed pilot start date: Aug 17 (day-zero ops). We can shift based on your schedule.

I cc'd Jordan and Marissa to confirm onboarding ramp and billing timeline once the signatory list is final.

Thanks — Lukas
Lukas Meyer | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: Avery_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP), Eval_Summary_Avery_20250724.xlsx (evaluation summary)

From: Claire Donovan <claire@averyretail.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@averyretail.com>, Evan Ruiz <evan.ruiz@averyretail.com>
Date: 2025-07-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + decision authority & signature window

Hi Lukas —

Thanks for sending this over. Quick answers:
- Decision authority: myself (VP Product), Evan Ruiz (Director of Security), and Procurement (procurement@averyretail.com). Legal will run a final pass but signoff authority sits with Product + Procurement.
- Procurement prefers a 72-hour review window once legal confirms — they typically need a PO reference number to expedite.
- We can target the Aug 6–8 window as first preference.

I'll route the MAP to legal today; we have a legal touchpoint tomorrow morning and should have initial redline feedback within 48 hours. I'll loop Evan if security needs to add anything to the evaluation notes.

Best,
Claire
Claire Donovan | VP Product | Avery Retail

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Donovan <claire@averyretail.com>
Date: 2025-07-28T12:01:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP + decision authority & signature window — need legal + CS sync

Kimberly / Jordan / Marissa — forwarding Claire's confirmation. Action items: please see below from Claire. We need:
- Kimberly: quick read of the attached MAP & eval summary; if legal can prepare a redline guide, we can incorporate prior to DocuSign. If you can commit to delivering SOW redlines by EOD 7/30 that aligns with their 48h expectation.
- Jordan: outline a 5-day onboarding ramp (day 0–4) and a recommended canary scope we can include in the MAP. Claire asked for a pilot start around Aug 17; we should confirm whether day-zero ops needs a runbook or a dedicated kickoff call.
- Marissa: pricing and billing note — if procurement asks for a PO reference on the invoice, what exact code should we include? We may need to provide a billing string they can reference.

I want to present a single consolidated plan back to Claire: final MAP + SOW redlines + DocuSign envelope with the signers listed. If legal can make a clear acceptance clause for the pilot (so Procurement can cut a PO against it), that's ideal.

Thanks — Lukas

> On Jul 28, 2025, Claire Donovan wrote:
> > Decision authority: myself (VP Product), Evan Ruiz (Director of Security), and Procurement (procurement@averyretail.com).
> > Procurement prefers a 72-hour review window once legal confirms.
> > Target Aug 6–8 signature window.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Donovan <claire@averyretail.com>
Date: 2025-07-30T09:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft MAP + decision authority & signature window — legal redlines attached

Lukas / team —

I reviewed the MAP and eval summary and attached a concise redline file (SOW_redlines_legal_20250730.pdf). High level:
- Two recommended edits to the pilot acceptance language (clarify MQL for go/no-go and tie rollback conditions to error-rate thresholds observed in their eval).
- Minor data residency/retention wording to match our Private deployment options.
- Standard indemnity clause flagged for their legal to confirm.

Timing: I can turn this into a DocuSign-ready SOW and run the envelope if Claire confirms the signer list. Given Claire's preferred Aug 6–8 window, I recommend we aim to have final redlines in DocuSign by EOD 7/31 to give them the 72-hour procurement window.

Attachments: SOW_redlines_legal_20250730.pdf

Kimberly Park | Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@averyretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@averyretail.com>, Evan Ruiz <evan.ruiz@averyretail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-30T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Final plan: signature slot Aug 7, DocuSign link + kickoff date Aug 12

Claire / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per legal's redlines and procurement's timing, proposed final schedule:
- DocuSign envelope sent: Aug 6 at 10:00 AM PT (Kimberly will manage).
- Preferred signature completion window: Aug 6–7 (we left Aug 8 as contingency).
- Requested PO reference on DocuSign and invoice: AR-2025-117-PO (procurement, please confirm if that maps to your system).
- Official pilot / kickoff: Aug 12, 2025 — day-zero will include a 60-minute kickoff with Jordan and the ops team, then a 5-day canary scope (Jordan to share runbook).

Links & attachments:
- Final MAP: https://redwood.app/s/drive/Avery-MAP-v3 (mirror attached)
- DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/status/ABC123-avery
- Legal redlines attached: SOW_redlines_legal_20250730.pdf

Claire, if this works, Kim will send the envelope tomorrow morning and procurement can attach the PO reference in the envelope comments. Jordan — can you share the 5-day onboarding cadence and day-zero agenda by EOD Friday so I can embed it into the MAP?

Appreciate the quick coordination — looking forward to getting Avery live.

Best,
Lukas Meyer | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: SOW_redlines_legal_20250730.pdf
